items.title: Why Is Eli Lilly (LLY) Getting A Bigger Role For Mounjaro?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) received FDA approval for Mounjaro (tirzepatide) to reduce cardiovascular risk in adults with type 2 diabetes. The decision expands Mounjaro’s use beyond blood sugar control to include reduction of cardiovascular events in at-risk patients. Mounjaro is the first dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist to gain this cardiovascular risk reduction indication.
